svg.title: Mariama Liner - interpreted silhouette
svg.desc: Traders and Gunboats (2024), printed 138-139, PDF 139-140. Matched two-deck exterior preserves asymmetric paired bodies, two cross-connections, central open gap and long aft machinery projection on only the left body. Plan alignment is supported by matching grid/profiles. Illustration confirms unequal hulls and connecting bridges. The central void remains a true even-odd hole; fuel/room borders excluded.
